summary.text: Zon Eastes is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Windham-1 District who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works as a conductor.

paragraphs.text: Zon Eastes was born in Kansas, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Mexico and a master's degree from Stony Brook University.
His career experience includes working as a conductor.
Eastes assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
